routes.name: إقامة للعمل لمدة سنتين (Work residence, two years)
إقامة للعمل لمدة سنة واحدة (Work residence, one year)
إقامة لغرض الالتحاق (Residence to join a family member)

note: Bahrain, read on 2026-10-30 in the Minister of the Interior's Decision No. 196 of 2014 on the fees for the services of the General Directorate of Nationality, Passports and Residence (issued 30 September 2014, Official Gazette No. 3177 of 2 October 2014), in the Legislation and Legal Opinion Commission's official legislation database (lloc.gov.bh), with the amending decisions it lists. Its fee table (fee in dinars, service, item number) gives: item 23, issuing or renewing a new residence for work for one year, BD 10; item 25, issuing a new residence for work for two years or renewing it, BD 20; item 28, issuing a new residence to join (iltihaq, a family member) for two years, BD 50, and item 29 its renewal, BD 60; item 30, issuing or renewing a residence under personal sponsorship of every kind, including the return visa, for two years, BD 200. Each is written with its fee and term, and as renewable since the table prices its renewal; the work residence is written as two routes, one per term. The table's column order was checked against the amending decisions, which restate rows in the order item, service, fee: item 22 (converting a visit visa to a work visa, BD 60 in 2014, BD 250 since Decision 16 of 2024 and Decision 119 of 2024) and item 12 sit where the 2014 table puts them. The amendments read (Decisions 139 of 2016, 102 of 2018, 142 of 2019, 134 of 2020, 36 and 136 of 2022, 36 of 2023, 16, 86 and 119 of 2024, 60 of 2026) change items 1, 3, 12, 20, 21, 22, 42, 43, 45, 53, 54, 60, 61, 63, 67 and 68 and add 63 to 75; none touches items 23, 25, 28 to 30. The database counts twelve amendments and eleven were found, so one may be unread. The personal sponsorship residence is written as a card for any purpose (`general`), since the decision names no purpose. The decision gives no decision times, nor whether the work residence ties its holder to the employer (the Labour Market Regulatory Authority's site, which issues work permits, answered 403 today, as did bahrain.bh), nor anything of permanent residence or naturalisation; GCC citizens' free movement isn't from this source and isn't written.

sources.said: بشأن الرسوم الخاصة بخدمات الإدارة العامة للجنسية والجوازات والإقامة ... 30 سبتمبر 2014م ... جدول الرسوم الخاصة بخدمات الإدارة العامة للجنسية والجوازات والإقامة ... مقدار الرسم الخدمة ت دينار فلس ... 10 جوازات السفر (الدائمة) 1 ... 60 تحويل تأشيرات الزيارة بأنواعها وتأشيرة التحاق إلى تأشيرات عمل ... 10 إصدار أو تجديد إقامة جديدة للعمل لمدة سنة واحدة 23 ... 20 إصدار إقامة جديدة للعمل لمدة سنتين أو تجديدها 25 ... 50 إصدار إقامة جديدة لغرض الالتحاق لمدة سنتين 28 ... 60 تجديد إقامة جديدة لغرض الالتحاق لمدة سنتين 29 ... 200 إصدار أو تجديد إقامة بكفالة شخصية بجميع أنواعها وشاملة تأشيرة العودة لمدة سنتين 30
